blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Object hallucination remains a major obstacle for large vision-language models (LVLMs) to generate reliable content. An intuitive mitigation strategy is to suppress hallucination-related components in hidden representations. However, these components may also contain useful information, and suppressing them can weaken the model's multimodal capabilities. In this paper, we propose ResOT, a training-free method that repairs representations at inference time through localized distribution alignment. Specifically, ResOT projects dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace, forming a low-dimensional residual subspace for intervention. Within this subspace, ResOT uses Gaussian optimal transport (OT) to align the hallucinated distribution with the faithful one. The resulting map defines repair targets with minimal changes to the original representations. At inference, ResOT adaptively controls how far each token state moves toward its OT target. Experiments on three representative LVLMs show that ResOT substantially reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance across multiple benchmarks. Code will be released.
blocks.zh: 对象幻觉仍然是大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)产生可靠内容的主要障碍. 一种直观的缓解策略是在隐藏的表示中抑制与幻觉相关的成分. 然而,这些组成部分也可能包含有用的信息,加以压制可能会削弱模型的多式联运能力。 在本文中,我们提出ResOT,这是一种无培训方法,通过局部分布调整来修复推断时的表述. 具体来说,ResOT项目将主力幻觉方向从忠实的子空间向外,形成一个低维的剩余子空间进行干预. 在这个子空间内,ResOT使用高斯最佳传输(OT)使幻觉的分布与忠实者一致. 由此形成的地图定义了修复目标,对原始表述的修改最小. 推断,ResOT适应性地控制着每个象征状态向OT目标移动的程度. 对三个具有代表性的LVLMs的实验表明,ResOT可以大大减少物体的幻觉,同时改善图像标题的质量和跨多个基准的多式联运性能。 代码将被发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can generate fluent and informative responses to visual input ( Bai et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024b ) , but they still describe objects that are not present in the image. This phenomenon, known as object hallucination, undermines the reliability of LVLMs ( Bai et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Rohrbach et al., 2018 ) . One approach to reducing object hallucination is to fine-tune LVLMs with additional data, but this often incurs substantial training costs ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024a ) . Representation-based methods offer a training-free alternative by modifying the model’s hidden representations ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Some of these methods identify hallucination-related directions or subspaces and suppress the corresponding components ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Dastmalchi et al., 2026 ) . However, being associated with hallucination does not make a component specific to hallucination ( Hua et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . The same components may also carry useful information for visual understanding, so suppressing them can compromise image caption quality or multimodal capabilities.
blocks.zh: 大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)可以对视觉输入产生流畅而翔实的响应(Bai等,2023;Chen等,2024b),但它们仍然描述了图像中没有的物体. 这种现象被称作物体幻觉,会破坏LVLMs的可靠性(Bai等,2024;Li等,2023;Rohrbach等,2018. 减少物体幻觉的方法之一是用额外数据来微调LVLM,但这往往需要大量的培训费用(Jiang等,2024;Liu等,2024a)。 以代表为基础的方法通过修改模型的隐性表述提供了一种没有培训的替代办法(Liu等,2025;Lin等,2026)。 其中一些方法确定了与幻觉相关的方向或子空间并压制了相应的组件(Yang等,2025a;Dastmalchi等,2026.). 然而,与幻觉有关联并不能使幻觉特有的成分(Hua等,2025;Zhu等,2026.). 同样的组件也可能携带有用的信息来进行视觉理解,从而压制它们会损害图像字幕质量或多模式能力.

(b) Suppression compresses the orange cluster into a narrow band and also displaces some faithful points (blue arrows). blocks.en: Therefore, we seek to repair the hallucination-related components rather than discard them. Instead of simply reducing the contribution of these components, we use their distribution in faithful representations to set repair targets. Figure 1 illustrates the key distinction: suppression-based interventions reduce the variation of hallucinated representations along the selected direction, but may also inadvertently alter faithful representations; in contrast, repair-based interventions use the faithful distribution to define where the representation should move.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们寻求修复与幻觉有关的组件,而不是抛弃它们。 我们不是简单地减少这些组成部分的贡献,而是利用这些组成部分在忠实的表述中的分布来确定修复目标。 图1说明了主要区别:以抑制为基础的干预可以减少特定方向上幻觉表现的变异,但也可能无意中改变忠实表现;相反,以修复为基础的干预可以使用忠实分配来确定该表现应移动何处。

blocks.en: The choice of alignment space is also important, as it determines which distributional differences the repair addresses. The dominant faithful subspace is spanned by the leading directions of faithful representations. We examine a low-dimensional residual subspace orthogonal to it. Our held-out analysis shows that this residual subspace reveals a clearer mismatch between faithful and hallucinated representations (Section 4.4 ). Importantly, faithful representations are not confined to their dominant subspace; they still have components in the residual subspace. Removing these components would discard variation present in faithful representations. These observations motivate localized distribution alignment: expose and correct the residual mismatch while leaving components in the dominant faithful subspace unchanged.
blocks.zh: 对齐空间的选择也很重要,因为它决定了哪一个分布性地区别了修复地址. 信众占优势的子空间被信众代表的主要方向所覆盖. 我们检查一个低维残存的子空间正对面 我们的搁置分析表明,这一剩余子空间显示,忠实和有幻觉的表述之间有更明显的不匹配(第4.4节)。 重要的是,忠实的表述并不局限于其主导子空间;它们仍然有剩余子空间的组成部分. 删除这些成分将丢弃忠实表述中存在的变异。 这些观测激励了局部分布对接:暴露并纠正了剩余不匹配,同时将组件留在占优势的忠实子空间中不变.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce ResOT, a training-free method that implements this localized repair at inference time. During offline calibration, ResOT processes each image with its paired faithful and hallucinated descriptions to collect two sets of hidden representations. It estimates the dominant subspaces of these representations, then projects the dominant hallucinated directions away from the faithful subspace. The leading residual directions define the repair subspace. We project both sets of calibration representations into this subspace and fit a Gaussian distribution to each. Gaussian optimal transport (OT) then provides a closed-form map from the hallucinated distribution to the faithful one. During inference, ResOT projects the current token state into the same subspace and applies the map to obtain its repair target. A likelihood-based gate compares the projected state’s likelihood under the two fitted distributions and controls how far it moves toward the target. The resulting correction is added back to the hidden state along the residual directions, leaving the orthogonal component unchanged. The LVLM weights remain fixed throughout calibration and inference.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了ResOT,这是一种在推断时间执行这种局部修复的无培训方法. 在离线校正期间,ResOT用其配对的忠实和有幻觉的描述来处理每个图像,以收集两组隐藏的表示. 它估计了这些表示物的主导子空间,然后将主导性幻觉方向投射出远离忠实子空间. 主要剩余方向定义了修复子空间. 我们把两组的校正表示都投射到这个子空间 并配上高斯的分量 然后,高斯最佳运输(OT)提供了从幻觉分出到忠实者的封闭式地图. 在推论期间,ResOT将当前符号状态投射到同一个子空间,并应用地图来得到它的修复目标. 基于可能性的大门比较了两种配制分布下的预测状态的可能性,并控制它向目标移动多远。 由此产生的校正会沿着残取方向被添加回隐藏状态,使正交部分保持不变. LVLM的重量在整个校准和推论期间保持不变.

blocks.en: Our theoretical analysis supports the repair subspace and transport target. The residual subspace captures as much of the dominant hallucinated directions as possible while remaining orthogonal to the dominant faithful subspace, helping expose the residual differences to be repaired. In this subspace, if components are removed via orthogonal projection, suppression cannot match the original faithful distribution as long as those components are also present in the faithful representation. Gaussian OT instead aligns the fitted residual distributions with minimum expected squared displacement.
blocks.zh: 我们的理论分析支持修复子空间和运输目标. 剩余子空间能捕捉到尽可能多的占优势的幻觉方向,同时能活到占优势的忠实子空间上,帮助暴露出需要修复的剩余差异. 在这个子空间中,如果通过正交投影去除组件,压制无法与原始的忠实分布相匹配,只要这些组件也存在于忠实的表示中. Gaussian OT则将装配的残留分布与最小的预期平方位迁移相协调。

blocks.en: We combined ResOT with LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2023 ) and conducted experiments on multiple benchmarks. The results demonstrate that ResOT reduces object hallucination while improving image caption quality and multimodal performance. Compared to the vanilla models, it reduces the CHAIR s metric by 13.9%–46.8% and achieves average relative improvements of 27.67% and 5.86% on the BLEU-1 and MME metrics ( Papineni et al., 2002 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , respectively. On LLaVA-1.5, ResOT achieves the highest throughput among the evaluated inference-time methods that keep the LVLM weights unchanged. It retains 81.24% of the original model’s generation throughput (tokens per second) while requiring only an additional 8.15 MiB of peak GPU memory.
blocks.zh: 我们把 " 反应和机会 " 方案与LLaVA-1.5、mPLUG-Owl2和InstructBLIP(Liu等,2023年;Ye等,2024年;Dai等,2023年)合并,并进行了多项基准试验。 结果显示,ResOT减少了对象幻觉,同时提高了图像字幕质量和多模式性能. 与香草模型相比,该模型将CHAIR的度量衡减少了13.9%-46.8%,并在BLEU-1和MME度量衡上分别实现了27.67%和5.86%的平均相对改进(Papineni等人,2002年;Fu等人,2025年)。 在LLaVA-1.5上,ResOT在评价的推断时间方法中实现了最高的吞吐量,使LVLM重量保持不变. 它保留了原型的发电吞吐量(tokens每秒)的81.24%,同时只需要额外的8.15个峰值GPU内存.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 大视野语言模型中的幻觉

blocks.en: Object hallucination in LVLMs has been studied from multiple perspectives, such as visual perception, cross-modal alignment, and reliance on language priors ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2024 ; Xing et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ) . One line of research involves training-based methods, which typically use supervised fine-tuning ( Liu et al., 2024a ) , contrastive learning ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , RLHF ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , and DPO ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Yu et al., 2024a ) . However, these methods often require additional supervision signals and parameter optimization. Other approaches focus on interventions during decoding. They adjust token selections through visual contrast ( Leng et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024a ) , attention signals ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) , or intermediate-layer predictions ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chuang et al., 2024 ) . Although these methods avoid retraining, they can introduce substantial inference overhead due to extra forward passes or complex decoding procedures. Post-hoc approaches revise unsupported content using learned revisors ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) or visual verification ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . These methods add a correction stage after generation.
blocks.zh: LVLMs中的对象幻觉从多种角度进行了研究,如视觉感知,跨模式对接,以及依赖语言前传(赵等,2025;贾能等,2024;邢等,2024;刘等,2024b.). 一行研究涉及以培训为基础的方法,通常采用有监督的微调(Liu等,2024a),对比性学习(Jiang等,2024),RLHF(Sun等,2024)和DPO(Yang等,2025b; Yu et al., 2024a. (原始内容存档于2019-09-21). 然而,这些方法往往需要额外的监督信号和参数优化. 其他方法侧重于解码过程中的干预. 他们通过视觉对比来调整符号选择(Leng等,2024;Chen等,2024a),注意信号. (周克等,2025;黄克等,2024),或中层预测. (Wang等,2025;Chuang等,2024). 虽然这些方法避免了再培训,但由于额外提前通行证或复杂的解码程序,它们可以引入大量的推断间接费用。 后荷克方法使用已学习的重述器(周等,2024年)或可视化验证(殷等,2024年)来修改无支持的内容. 这些方法在生成后会增加一个校正阶段.

blocks.en: ResOT is most closely related to representation-based interventions. Existing methods steer latent activations ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , intervene on attention heads ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , or suppress hallucination-related components ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Dastmalchi et al., 2026 ) . More selective approaches use evidence-consistent subspace editing ( Lin et al., 2026 ) or targeted parameter updates ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) to limit interference with useful information. ResOT instead defines a faithful target distribution within a residual subspace. Its key distinction is the use of distribution alignment rather than component removal to determine the update.
blocks.zh: 反垄断委员会与基于代表性的干预关系最密切。 现有方法引导潜在活化(Liu等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年),干预注意力头(Chen等人,2025年),或抑制与幻觉有关的成分(Yang等人,2025年a;Dastmalchi等人,2026年)。 更有选择性的方法使用符合证据的子空间编辑(Lin等,2026年)或有针对性的参数更新(Zhu等,2026年)来限制对有用信息的干扰. ResOT则定义了剩余子空间内的忠实目标分布. 它的关键区别在于使用分布相配而不是去除组件来确定更新.

blocks.en: 2.2 Optimal Transport for Representation Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.2 代表制优化运输

blocks.en: Optimal transport (OT) aligns distributions by finding a transport plan that minimizes the cost of moving probability mass between them ( Villani, 2009 ; Peyré and Cuturi, 2019 ) . It has been widely used for feature alignment and domain adaptation ( Courty et al., 2017 ; Damodaran et al., 2018 ) . Empirical OT estimates a coupling between samples, often using iterative solvers such as Sinkhorn ( Cuturi, 2013 ) . Under squared Euclidean cost, the OT map between non-degenerate Gaussian distributions has a closed-form affine expression determined by their means and covariances ( Peyré and Cuturi, 2019 ) . ResOT uses this map to define repair targets in a low-dimensional residual subspace. The map is estimated offline and applied during generation, without an online transport solver.
blocks.zh: 优化运输(OT)通过找到一个运输计划来协调分布,将它们之间的移动概率质量成本降至最低(Villani,2009;Peyré和Cuturi,2019). 它被广泛用于地物对接和域名适应(Courty等,2017;Damodaran等,2018.). 经验 OT估计样本之间会相接相接,常使用Sinkhorn等迭代解析器(Cuturi,2013). . 在平方的欧几里得斯成本下,非德意志高斯分布之间的OT图具有由它们的手段和同分法决定的闭式相亲表达(Peyré and Cuturi, 2019). ResOT使用此映射在低维残基子空间中定义修复目标. 该地图在生成期间被估计为下行并被应用,没有在线运输解析器.

blocks.en: ResOT consists of two stages: offline calibration and online repair, as shown in Figure 2 . During calibration, a residual subspace is identified at each selected layer, and a Gaussian optimal transport map is estimated within this subspace. During inference, ResOT uses this map to define a repair target for the current token state and adaptively controls the movement toward that target.
blocks.zh: 如图2所显示的,ResOT包括两个阶段:离线校正和在线修理。 在校正期间,在每个所选的地层都确定了一个剩余子空间,在这个子空间内估计出高斯最佳迁移图. 在推论期间,ResOT使用这个地图来定义当前符号状态的修复目标,并适应性地控制向该目标移动.

By combining these visual features with the prompt text x x , the decoder can generate a response autoregressively. At decoding step t t , the available context consists of the image, the prompt, and the previously generated tokens y < t y_{<t} . blocks.en: Like prior representation-based interventions ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , ResOT uses a paired calibration set to determine where to repair and how the repair should be performed. The set contains N N images, each paired with a faithful description and a hallucinated description. We process the two image–description inputs separately and extract the hidden state at the final text position of each complete description. At each selected layer, stacking these states gives Z F ℓ , Z H ℓ ∈ ℝ N × d Z_{F}^{\ell},Z_{H}^{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times d} . We refer to them as faithful and hallucinated representations according to the descriptions from which they are extracted.
blocks.zh: 如先前以代表为基础的干预 (杨等,2025a;朱等,2026.),Res. OT使用配对校正装置来确定修理地点和如何进行修理。 该集包含N N图像,每集有忠实描述和幻觉描述. 我们分别处理两个图像 - 描述输入,并在每个完整描述的最后文本位置提取隐藏状态 。 在每一个选定的层上,堆放这些状态会给出 Z F l, Z H l → ∈ R N × d _{ F}^{\ell }, Z_{H}^{\ell}\in\ mathbb{R}^{N\times d}. 我们根据从中提取的描述,把他们称为忠实和有幻觉的表述。

blocks.en: ResOT estimates its subspaces and transport maps from these complete descriptions and reuses them at the current decoding position. This follows the strategy of deriving textual steering directions from final-position representations of paired captions and applying them during generation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . During the calibration and inference stages, the parameters of the LVLM remain fixed.
blocks.zh: ResOT从这些完整描述中估计出它的子空间和运输地图,并在目前的解码位置再用. 这遵循的战略是,从成对标题的最终位置表述中得出文字指导方向,并在生成时加以应用(Liu等人,2025年)。 在校正和推断阶段,LVLM的参数保持不变.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce ResOT, which mitigates object hallucination by repairing hallucination-related representations rather than directly suppressing them. ResOT confines the intervention to the residual subspace and uses Gaussian optimal transport to move representations toward a faithful target with minimum expected squared displacement. A likelihood-based gate further adjusts how much of this correction is applied during decoding. Across multiple benchmarks and three representative LVLMs, ResOT consistently reduces object hallucination while preserving or even improving image caption quality and broader multimodal performance. These results indicate that hallucination-related components do not always need to be removed; repairing their distribution provides a practical alternative to direct suppression.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了ResOT,它通过修复与幻觉相关的表达而非直接压制来减轻物体的幻觉. resOT将干预限制在剩余子空间,并采用高斯最佳运输方式,将代表物移向最小预期平方流离失所的忠实目标。 基于概率的闸门会进一步调整这种校正在解码过程中应用了多少. 通过多种基准和三种具有代表性的LVLM,ResOT不断减少物体幻觉,同时保持甚至改进图像标题质量和更广泛的多模式性能。 这些结果表明,与幻觉相关的成分并不总是需要去除;修复其分布提供了可替代直接抑制的实用方法.

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation and Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 执行和评价详情

blocks.en: We evaluate ResOT on LLaVA-1.5-7B, InstructBLIP-Vicuna-7B, and mPLUG-Owl2-LLaMA2-7B. For the vanilla models and ResOT, we use greedy decoding. For each backbone, we use the same 5,000 calibration pairs from the LURE training data ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Each pair contains an image from the COCO training set, a faithful caption from LLaVA-Instruct-150K, and a corresponding hallucinated caption generated by GPT-3.5.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了LLaVA-1.5-7B、InstructBLIP-Vicuna-7B和mPLUG-Owl2-LLAMA2-7B上的ResOT。 对于香草模型和ResOT,我们使用贪婪的解码. 每根骨干,我们使用LURE训练数据(周等,2024年)中相同的5000个校正对. 每对都包含来自COCO训练集的图像,来自LLaVA-Instruct-150K的忠实字幕,以及由GPT-3.5生成的相应幻觉字幕.

blocks.en:
For POPE, we evaluate on the random, popular, and adversarial splits, each containing 3,000 samples. We parse each response by checking whether its first generated word is “yes” or “no”; otherwise, the prediction is labeled as unknown and counted as incorrect.
For CHAIR, we evaluate object hallucination on the COCO 2014 validation set ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Following prior work ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) , we use the subset of 500 images selected by OPERA for evaluation. We use the fixed prompt: Please describe this image in detail .
For MME, we follow the official yes/no evaluation protocol. Each image is paired with two questions, and the score combines question-level accuracy with image-level pair accuracy.
For GPT-assisted open-ended evaluation, we use GPT-4o as an external judge to assess image description quality. Given an image, the prompt and two model responses, GPT-4o assigns each response a score from 1 to 10 for visual accuracy and detailedness. We repeat each comparison five times and report the mean score.
blocks.zh:
对POPE来说,我们评估随机、流行和对抗的分数,每个分数包含3,000个样本。 我们通过检查第一个生成的单词是“是”还是“否”来分析每个响应;否则,预测被贴上未知的标签并算作不正确。
对于ChaAIR,我们评价COCO 2014验证集上的物体幻觉(Lin等,2014年). 继先前的工作(Huang等,2024;Yang等,2025a)后,我们使用OPERA选取的500个图像的子集进行评估. 我们使用固定的提示: 请详细描述这一形象。
对于MME,我们遵循官方的"是"/"否"评价协议. 每个图像都配对出两个问题,分数结合了问题级精度和图像级精度.
对于GPT协助的开放式评价,我们使用GPT-4o作为外部裁判来评估图像描述质量. 鉴于一个图像,即时和两个模型响应,GPT-4o为每个响应分配了从1到10的分数,用于视觉精度和细节. 我们重复每次比较五次,并报告平均分.

blocks.en: We compare with decoding-based methods, including OPERA, VCD, HALC, and SGRS, and representation-level methods, including ICT, VTI, VISTA, Nullu, HulluEdit, and Revis. For each baseline, we use the official code and the hyperparameters recommended in the corresponding paper. Vanilla and ResOT use greedy decoding. OPERA uses beam search with five beams, while SGRS uses saliency-guided top-k rejection sampling. Within each benchmark, we keep the LVLM backbone, prompt, and maximum generation length the same across all methods.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了基于编码的方法,包括OPERA、VCD、HALC和SGRS,以及代表级方法,包括信通技术、VTI、VISTA、Nullu、HulluEdit和Revis。 对于每个基线,我们使用官方代码和相应纸张中推荐的超参数. 香草和ResOT使用贪婪的解码. OPERA使用有5个光束的光束搜索,而SGRS则使用有分光导出上-克的拒绝采样. 在每个基准中,我们保持LVLM主干线,快速,最大生成长度在所有方法中相同.

blocks.en: ResOT uses two rank parameters. The rank r r determines the number of dominant directions used to estimate the faithful and hallucinated subspaces, while k k determines the dimension of the residual repair subspace. We set r = k r=k and select this shared rank from { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 } \{8,16,32,64,128\} . The repair strength α \alpha is selected from { 0.1 , 0.2 , … , 1.0 } \{0.1,0.2,\ldots,1.0\} . At each decoding step, repair is applied only to the final-position hidden state in decoder layers 16–31. We set the covariance shrinkage coefficient to ρ = 0.05 \rho=0.05 and the numerical stability term to ϵ = 10 − 6 \epsilon=10^{-6} . For each layer, the correction threshold is set to the 95th percentile of OT correction norms computed from the hallucinated calibration representations.
blocks.zh: ResOT使用两个等级参数. 分级r决定了用于估计忠实和有幻觉的子空间的主导方向数量,而k k则决定了剩余修补子空间的维度. 我们设置 r = k r = k 从 { 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 } \ 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 } 选择这个共享的级别 。 修复强度 α\ alpha 是从 { 0.1, 0.2, ...., 1.0 } {0. 1, 0.2,\ ildots, 1. 0 } 中选出 。 在每个解码步骤上,修复只应用到解码层16–31中的最终位置隐藏状态. 我们把共变收缩系数设定为 ^ 0.05\rho= 0.05, 数值稳定性术语设定为 → 10 = 6\epsilon= 10\6}。 对于每一层,校正阈值被设定为从幻觉校正表达值中计算出来的OT校正规范的第95%.

blocks.en: We split the calibration set by image into fitting and validation subsets of 4,500 and 500 pairs, respectively. The fitting subset is used to estimate the residual subspaces and Gaussian OT maps, while the validation subset is used to select the shared rank r = k r=k and repair strength α \alpha . For each candidate configuration, we measure generative hallucination using CHAIR i \mathrm{CHAIR}_{i} based on COCO ground-truth object annotations, object-level multimodal preservation using balanced accuracy on yes/no questions constructed from present and absent objects, and generation quality using BLEU-1 against the faithful reference captions. We first retain the five configurations with the highest balanced accuracy, and then select the one with the best average rank across CHAIR i \mathrm{CHAIR}_{i} and BLEU-1. After selecting r = k r=k and α \alpha , we estimate the residual subspaces and Gaussian OT maps using all 5,000 calibration pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们把图像设定的校正分为4,500对和500对的装配和验证子集。 配位子集用于估计剩余子空间和高斯OT地图,而验证子集则用于选择共享的级 r = k r = k 并修复强度 α\ alpha . 对于每个候选配置,我们根据COCO地面真实对象说明使用CHAIR i\mathrm{CHAIR}_{i}测量基因幻觉,利用平衡精确度从当前和缺失对象构建的"是"/"否"问题进行对象级多式保存,利用BLEU-1对忠实的参考标题进行生成质量. 我们首先保留最均衡准确的五种配置,然后选择在CHAIR i\mathrm{CHAIR}_{i}和BLEU-1上获得最佳平均分级的配置. 在选择了 r = k r 和 α- α后,我们用所有的 5000 个校正对对来估计剩余子空间和高斯OT 地图.

blocks.en: Across the methods reported in Table 5 , ResOT achieves the highest scores on BLEU-1–4 ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , ROUGE-L ( Lin, 2004 ) , CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) and SPICE ( Anderson et al., 2016 ) for all three backbones. blocks.en: We further evaluate ResOT on additional hallucination and multimodal benchmarks. AMBER ( Wang et al., 2023 ) provides fine-grained analysis of object hallucination, while MMHal-Bench ( Sun et al., 2024 ) evaluates hallucination in open-ended responses. We also use MM-Vet ( Yu et al., 2024b ) , MMMU ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , TextVQA ( Singh et al., 2019 ) , ScienceQA ( Lu et al., 2022 ) , and MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024c ) to assess broader multimodal capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步根据更多的幻觉和多模式基准来评估反弹道导弹系统。 AMBER(Wang等,2023年)提供了对物体幻觉的精细分析,而MMHal-Bench(Sun等,2024年)则在开放式反应中评价了幻觉. 我们还利用MM-Vet(Yu等,2024b),MMMU(Yue等,2024),TextVQA(Singh等,2019),ScienceQA(Lu等,2022),MMBench(Liu等,2024c)来评估更广泛的多模式能力.

blocks.en: On AMBER, ResOT achieved the lowest CHAIR, Hal, and Cog scores on all three backbones (Table 6 ). Its object coverage remains close to the best result for each backbone. Therefore, the reduction in hallucinations is accompanied by a slight change in the object coverage.

blocks.en: ResOT improves the overall MM-Vet score across all three backbones (Table 8 ). Performance varies across individual skills, but the overall score consistently increases for every model. Together with the hallucination results, this suggests that ResOT reduces hallucination without broadly degrading multimodal capability.
blocks.zh: REOT改进了所有三个骨干整体的MM-Vet分数(表8). 个人技能的表现各有不同,但每个模型的总体得分持续增加。 这与幻觉结果一起表明,ResOT减少幻觉,而不会普遍降低多式联运能力。

blocks.en: Across MMMU, TextVQA, ScienceQA, and MMBench, ResOT consistently outperforms Nullu across all three backbones (Table 9 ). Compared with the vanilla models, ResOT improves performance in 9 of the 12 settings and matches the baseline in one, with only modest decreases on TextVQA for mPLUG-Owl2 and InstructBLIP. Overall, the results show that ResOT preserves or improves general multimodal performance while reducing hallucination.

blocks.en: Table 10: Inference efficiency on LLaVA-1.5 with 128 generated tokens. Changes are computed against each method’s paired Vanilla run.

blocks.en: ResOT estimates the residual subspace and Gaussian OT map offline, while online inference only applies the transport maps to the current token hidden representations. Let L L denote the number of intervened layers. At each layer, projection into the residual subspace and reconstruction in the original representation space cost O ⁡ ( d ​ k ) O(dk) . Evaluating the affine transport map and the Gaussian likelihood ratio costs O ⁡ ( k 2 ) O(k^{2}) , while correction clipping costs O ⁡ ( k ) O(k) . Storing the residual bases, transport maps, and Gaussian statistics requires O ⁡ ( L ⁡ ( d ​ k + k 2 ) ) O(L(dk+k^{2})) memory.

blocks.en: D.3 Gaussian Diagnostics in the Residual Subspace
blocks.zh: D.3 残留子空间的高斯诊断

blocks.en: ResOT models faithful and hallucinated residual representations with Gaussian distributions to obtain a closed-form transport map. We therefore examine how well this approximation describes the residual representations used to estimate the OT maps. We use the same 5,000 calibration pairs after hyperparameter selection. At each layer, faithful and hallucinated residual vectors are whitened separately using their estimated means and covariances. For the marginal analysis, we aggregate the whitened coordinate values across samples and dimensions and compare them with 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1 ) \mathcal{N}(0,1) . To examine the joint distribution, we compute the squared Mahalanobis distance of each residual vector and compare its distribution with χ k 2 \chi_{k}^{2} , where k k is the residual dimension.
blocks.zh: ResOT模型以高斯分布的忠实和有幻觉的残留代表来得到封闭式的运输图. 因此,我们审查这一近似描述用于估计OT地图的剩余表述情况如何。 我们使用同样的5000个校准对 经过超参数选择。 在每一层,忠实和有幻觉的残余载体分别使用其估计手段和同分力被白化. 对于边际分析,我们汇总了整个样本和维度所显示的白坐标值,并将其与 N 相比较 (0, 1)\ mathcal{N} (0, 1) 。 为了检查联合分布,我们计算每个残余矢量的平方马哈拉诺比斯相距,并将其分布与QQ k 2\chi_{k}^{2}比较,其中k k是剩余维度.

blocks.en: Overall, these diagnostics support using a Gaussian model as a compact approximation of the residual distributions rather than as an exact description of their full shape. ResOT uses the estimated means and covariances to construct the transport map, while the observed departures from Gaussianity are concentrated more strongly in the joint distribution and its tails.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些诊断支持使用高斯模型作为剩余分布的紧凑近似,而不是精确描述其全形. ResOT使用估计手段和共变来构建运输图,而所观测出从高斯亚地层的出行更被集中到联合分布及其尾部.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: ResOT uses a low-dimensional Gaussian model to define the transport target. This model can capture differences in mean and covariance but does not describe all higher-order structure in the residual distributions. In addition, calibration uses representations from complete descriptions, whereas repair is applied to a partially generated context. This potential distributional shift remains insufficiently explored. Our evaluation focuses primarily on object hallucination. The applicability of ResOT to other forms of multimodal error remains to be verified.
blocks.zh: ResOT使用低维高斯模型来定义运输目标. 这个模型可以捕捉到平均和共变的差别,但并没有描述剩余分布中所有更高级的结构. 此外,校正使用完整描述中的表述,而修复则用于部分产生的上下文。 这种潜在的分配转移仍未得到充分探讨。 我们的评估主要侧重于物体幻觉。 ResOT是否适用于其他形式的多式联运出错仍有待核实。
